tess_partnerships: Heads-up: AMD flagged a customs hold on MI300 pilot boards, ~2 week delay. Need a quick decision: split waves or announce core SKUs and note MI300 as partner preview?
anna_amd: Confirmed. ETA now early July. Trying to expedite one validation batch but can't promise.
rajesh_si: SI impact: we can't finalize MI300 test images until hardware arrives. If we split waves, we can still certify H100/H200/B200 on schedule.
oliver_nvidia: Nvidia side is green for H100/H200/B200. We can supply H200 test image for SI teams today.
helen_ops: Ops constraint: SKU metadata + image URIs required 72h before publish. Two-wave approach ok but needs separate release notes and SKU suffixes.
sam_legal: Messaging: use "partner preview" or "coming soon" for MI300. Avoid firm public dates and require partner asset sign-off for joint PRs.
release-bot: Event created: "Marketplace announce (core SKUs)"  2026-06-22  https://calendar.redwood.ai/e/mkt-core-2026-06-22
tess_partnerships: Decision: proceed with core SKUs (H100/H200/B200) on 2026-06-22, list MI300 as "partner preview / coming soon" and run a partner-only validation batch when boards arrive. Owners: comms=tess_partnerships, SI=rajesh_si, ops=helen_ops, vendor=anna_amd, legal=sam_legal.
rajesh_si: I'll open a "preview" CI lane to skip mi300 jobs and prepare a cert checklist for the partner batch.
anna_amd: I'll update this thread with any ETA changes and the validation batch plan.
tess_partnerships: Thanks everyone, keep posting updates here. Closing for now. :white_check_mark:
